source.description: runClaudeRuntimeSyncPhase with isGlobal=true replaces the entire hooks section of ~/.claude/settings.json with project-scoped paths (hardcoded <projectRoot>/.xtrm/hooks/). This: (1) wipes hand-configured global hooks (PreCompact bd prime, SessionStart bd prime + context-mode-cache-heal), (2) duplicates every hook since project .claude/settings.json already has them, (3) hardcodes the current project path — breaks if run from any other project. Fix: early return when isGlobal=true, still calling ensureGlobalStatusLine() for statusLine wiring.
source.title: fix: xt install --global must not overwrite project hooks into ~/.claude/settings.json
